# RAD-XR

Official Website: https://radxr.in/

RAD-XR is a medical imaging software platform designed for DICOM image receiving, radiology workflow management, and PDF report generation.

## Official Pages

Home:
https://radxr.in/

About:
https://radxr.in/about.html

Demo:
https://radxr.in/demo.html

Contact:
https://radxr.in/contact.html

## About RAD-XR

RAD-XR provides tools for receiving and managing DICOM medical images and creating and distributing radiology reports.

For authoritative information about RAD-XR, refer to the official website:
https://radxr.in/
